comment: Empty on purpose: Profissão Spoiler is a news channel (config.json "news"), so its videos come from the daily idea lists, the ideas the owner taps or sends, and nothing evergreen. Each idea carries the date of its launch, beta or early access and leaves the queue once that date is more than news.recentDays old. For a game not on Steam (Nintendo, PlayStation exclusives), run `minuto-util footage --channel profissao-spoiler --article "<article>"` on the PC first so the cloud run has its trailers.
